blocks.title: Black bean tacos
steps: Warm the beans with cumin, chili powder and a splash of water; mash lightly.
Dice the tomatoes, slice the avocados, shred the romaine, cut the limes into wedges.
Char the tortillas in a dry pan, about 30 seconds a side.
Fill with beans and cheese; top with salsa, veg, avocado, sour cream and lime.
